Based on the provided evidence, the published study is a review article that outlines the strengths and limitations of conventional and novel (microfluidic) EV isolation methods, discusses commercially available kits, and assesses global market demand. It does not propose, develop, or experimentally validate any specific polymer matrix (such as P(NIPAM-co-BMA-co-NHSMA)), specific acoustic microfluidic platform with electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, or specialized aptamer-copolymer capture system. 

Consequently, none of the candidate hypotheses represent the main hypothesis supported by this study.

VERDICT 1: REJECT
